description: Frozen vector cases whose expectation spec revision v1.2 (minor) changed, in the layout of SUPERSEDED.json, which stays byte-identical (core section 0, v1.2 amendment: every revision lists its superseded cases in its own file). A checker or test of v1.2 or later skips a frozen case only through SUPERSEDED.json and these lists, and runs replaced_by instead, on the same inputs.
